scientific_integrity: The critical-value fiber theorem is established by universal quadratic/cubic factorizations and a rational quartic with three exact barycentric witnesses. The motivating 2026 manuscript was withdrawn because its all-shifts theorem was incorrect; that result is not used.
scientific_limitations: The equality is universal only in degrees 2 and 3, while degree 4 is an explicit counterexample. No higher-degree classification or all-shifts claim. A same-topic August 2026 JMAA full text could not be inspected for historical priority.
title: Degree four is the first obstruction to critical-value sampling of polynomial root hulls
verification_note: Exact symbolic checks corroborate the rational witness and generic cubic factorization; they are not formal or external expert certification.
